scope: Independent preserved analog/button functions plus new power/buffer topology; no hardware or final routing approval
corrected_defect: Original rev23 assigned U1 pins8/28 to BB_FAULT/LCD_VIO_PRESENT despite MCP23017 output-only limitation. Fresh source now NC, symbols output-only, signals moved to J12 for direct HAT GPIO.
remaining_requirements: Final power route must retain local C24/C25/C26 and C33-C36 bypass connections and continuous filled ground return.
LCD VIO must physically tap real display regulated3V3; the11-pin connector does not expose it.
Only common-ground0-24V DC meter; hardware offset/gain calibration, reverse/fault/brownout/transient behavior untested.
Prototype output100mA is a recommended working load, not a100mA maximum trip threshold; exact210k gives110-150mA before resistor tolerance.
LCD_VIO_PRESENT is a presence indication, not a precise brownout/power-good comparator.
HAT GPIO6/7 input mapping and external failsafe pulldowns are a separate matching-HAT requirement.
